description: 研究の記憶（MEMORY.md / logs/）の読み込み・記録漏れ防止・承認制を強制する

hooks.prompt:
You judge whether a research-log entry is missing. Below is the information (JSON) at the end of a Claude Code response.

$ARGUMENTS

Rules:
1. If stop_hook_active is true, always return {"ok": true}.
2. Read last_assistant_message and decide whether any of the following happened in this turn: (a) a research decision was settled (research question, hypothesis, metric, baseline, data split, adopting or rejecting a method, etc.); (b) a discussion or interpretation of experimental results was given; (c) the user reported something decided with the advisor, in a seminar, or in a meeting; (d) the user explained the intent of a code change they made; (e) a research-relevant finding from related work was obtained.
3. If any applies and the response does not show that it was already recorded in logs/ (e.g., a block was appended to the log), return {"ok": false, "reason": "<1-2 sentences on what to record; tell Claude to record it in the log with the research-log Skill (the meeting-note Skill for meeting reports), writing the record in Japanese>"}.
4. Return {"ok": true} for general programming questions, work that does not affect the research, things already recorded, or cases too minor to be sure.
Output JSON only.
